answer: A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 17 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes a horizon bet on surviving 40 epochs of grading, and every tundra settlement recomputes the hollow schedule, so anyone who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 40 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 13 dollars per alias. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
